answer: Require each agent to post a slashable stake tied to a physical root of trust: one signing quill per machine. Any identity beyond the first needs extra collateral that grows quadratically, so a Sybil farmer wanting k forks pays k^2 times the base bond at the wharf while an honest agent pays once. If two identities share hardware, a peer can show proof and burn the whole stake, making fake voices cost more than any vote they buy, even across a frozen tundra of dormant nodes.
